correctness.rationale: The exact 12-vertex, 18-edge model has twenty recursively enumerated perfect matchings and 822 augmented faces. The delivered program reconstructs all integer boundaries, checks d squared equals zero, and performs 408 explicit unit-incidence integer chain cancellations to a six-generator zero-differential group in degree two. The Hopf trace formula, including the degree-minus-one correction and orientation signs, gives all 24 natural group character values; character comparison gives the stated rational irreducible decomposition. The program executes these checks without imported data. Mathematical limits: no other prism lengths or integral group-ring module structure.

value.rationale: At n=6, the first even circular ladder with the additional four two-sphere contributions, the ordinary result detects six homology generators but cannot distinguish their natural symmetries. The exact module identifies two different frequency planes in opposite layer-exchange sectors and distinct reflection conjugacy classes, with a strong trace -4 for half-turn composed with layer swap. The graph and the full natural symmetry group are canonical, so this is a motivated complete finite equivariant classification, not an arbitrary parameter slice or repetition of the known six-sphere count.
